beats.care: Commuting via Dadar on Tuesday? Use S K Bole Road, Gokhale Road or L J Road, or take the train.
beats.what: Swatantryaveer Savarkar Road closes from Siddhivinayak to Kapad Bazar. Parts of Keluskar Road and Lt Dilip Gupte Road also close.
beats.why: Police expect huge crowds at a Dussehra rally at Shivaji Park on October 20.

cards.body: Police suggest S K Bole Road, Agar Bazar, Portuguese Church and Gokhale Road; or L J Road to Steelman Junction; or M B Raut Marg.
cards.title: Detours

cards.body: Eight stretches are no-parking, including N C Kelkar Marg, L J Road and Pandurang Naik Marg.
cards.title: No parking

opts: Use the suggested detours or a train
Park on N C Kelkar Marg
cards.q: Best move if you must cross Dadar on Tuesday evening?
cards.why: Savarkar Road is closed and parking is banned, so detours or trains are the smart choice.

cards.q: How will you travel on Tuesday?

learn.t: Savarkar Road will be shut between Siddhivinayak temple junction and Kapad Bazar junction in Mahim.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Dussehra Melava 2026: Mumbai Traffic Police Announces Road Closures, Diversions & Parking Restrictions In Dadar On October 20

tldr: Mumbai Traffic Police will close and divert roads around Shivaji Park in Dadar from 8 am to 11:55 pm on October 20.
watch: Closures run 8 am to 11:55 pm on Tuesday, October 20; police may add more diversions.
